messages:
emma: OK team — Sunrise HackDay is 3 weeks out. Quick thread to lock down backstage + volunteer ops. We need a tight runbook for speaker handoff, swag vending, and post-event lead routing. Who owns the greenroom schedule?
ajay: I can own greenroom. Need a one-pager for volunteers + slide for MC.
marina: Volunteers: 6 total, staggered 2hr shifts. I put a tentative roster in the shared sheet: https://bit.ly/sunrise-hackday-roster
sophie: Can design make a 1-sheet for volunteers (do/don't), and a large poster with booth rules for stage? Prefer bold text: "Backstage access only" and a QR for speaker kit pickup.
design-team: Yep — will deliver volunteer sheet + 24x36 poster by EOD Thurs. Need exact copy for QR landing page.
ryan: For swag vending: we should do a mix of 2 premium items + 3 smalls. Inventory target: 250 premium, 500 smaller items. Also need a secure cashbox or Square reader?
lina: We'll use Square reader. Ops can hold the cashbox. I'll order 300 of the premium item (stickers + enamel) and 600 of the smaller (stickers, lip balm). ETA 10 business days.
ajay: Speaker timing: 7 talks, 12 min each + 3 min Q. Buffer of 10 mins every 2 talks. Greenroom needs a chalkboard with remaining slot times. Emma — can you share final schedule?
emma: Final schedule is attached in drive (shared). Key: speakers arrive 60 mins before slot, 20 min mic check. MC will call last call 5 mins before stage.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit an event permit request to VenuesOps by 1978571400 to get loading dock access.
marina: I submitted permit earlier — confirmation number VEN-4227. Parking passes: 6 vendor passes requested.
sophie: Lead capture flow: volunteers scan QR on badge to add to HubSpot list "Sunrise HackDay — booth leads". Post-event, we want first-touch email sent within 24 hrs and MQL routing to SDR queue if product interest = high.
ryan: Can we add a short screening question in the QR form: "Are you evaluating inference infra in next 6 months? (yes/no)" That will help routing.
lina: GDPR note: add checkbox for marketing contact. We'll add required consent on form.
emma: Post-event tasks: 1) Export leads CSV 2) Run dedupe + enrich 3) Push to HubSpot list. Who can own the export?
ajay: I'll own export and dedupe. Sophie — can you draft the 24hr email?
sophie: On it. Draft will be in /marketing/campaigns/sunrise-hackday/email-1.md by Monday.
design-team: Also prepping a small poster with our benchmark one-liner for booth: "Redwood Inference — predictable LLM inference at production scale." Want to keep it short; any edits?
emma: Fine. Maybe tweak to: "Production LLM inference: predictable latency, lower unit cost."
marina: Logistics for kit handoff: volunteers will have pre-packed kits in numbered tote bins. Use this packing checklist: ```1x mic pack, 1x charger, 1x speaker badge, 1x stage notes, 1x bottled water, 1x snack```
ryan: We'll label bins A-F by timeblocks. Volunteer lead should initial outbound kit on a signoff sheet.
lina: Swag storage: ops will keep extra 50 premium in locked crate. Don't leave high-value items unattended on the table.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled check-in reminder to volunteers 30 min before event: /remind @volunteers "Backstage check-in" at 1978571500
emma: Can we run a quick tabletop rehearsal 2 days before? 30 min run through with MC + AV. I'll book the rehearsal slot.
ajay: I'll be there for rehearsal and will bring spare XLR cables.
sophie: For post-event benchmark narrative: we should capture 3 quick stats in the followup — impressions at booth, number of MQLs, and a short anecdote from a technical conversation for social post. Anyone on note-taking?
marina: I'll take notes during the day and add a short summary doc in drive.
emma: Great. Final checklist for immediate owners: greenroom & export = ajay, volunteers roster & notes = marina, swag orders = lina, volunteer sheet + posters = design-team, 24hr email = sophie. If anything slips ping me. :thumbsup:
ryan: One more — does anyone have a spare CHP (charging hub) for demo laptops? We need 3 devices charged.
marina: Ops has a 6-port charger. I'll bring it.
nina: (not attending) Can we get a quick confirmation that the HubSpot form auto-tags campaign = sunrise-hackday? Otherwise routing will break.
emma: Confirmed — campaign param will be auto-attached.
ajay: Solid. Closing thread — we'll reconvene after rehearsal for any final changes. :rocket:
